notes.title: New Update 2.6.0 (OLD JANUARY PHYSICS + MANUAL CLUTCH)
notes.content:
Thanks for all feedback! So we decided to bring back Old January Physics!
So now you are able to do Back Entries, 360s, and more again!

Change Log:
- January arcadic physics!
- Manual Clutch (X - by default on Keyboard, also supported for Pedal in input settings)

We decided to listen much more the community, so new physics was a mistake, in the future we will listen only community, so the game will grow up, give your feedback and ideas in comments! Thank you, keep playing! See you in game!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11228669/b44fa83d923cef2376ade78e66613b580e9e6cde.png[/img]

notes.title: New Update is Ready! 25 Jan
notes.content:
Change Log:

New Next Gen Graphics! (Without Settings, will come in next update)
Modding Support! (Only maps now)
New Rims!
Fixed Scoring system, only works on the ground!
Fixed Camera rotation!
Fixed AE68 size to smaller.
Updated S240 (changed to stock! preparing for tuning bodykits)

[img]http://b.snapie.net/53effa53e8bbc823d1b6f988999f8491.png[/img]

Custom addon maps can be opened in LAN menu!
To play with friend on custom map, you both need to have the map in mods.

[img]http://b.snapie.net/de79eeb53781494698c3bb43eef0a8e8.png[/img]
[img]http://b.snapie.net/5b9584d054130818d33a8b4f00603ab3.png[/img]
[img]http://b.snapie.net/d337cb8b1f18c7b54f4f5d34803ff82b.png[/img]

Maps Modding How To:

Custom maps location: Game Folder/Drift Streets Japan_Data/mods/maps/map_name/map_name.obj + .mtl + textures
.mtl file is necessary!

notes.title: How to setup your controller! (Steering Wheel) (Guide)
notes.content:
In latest Update we added Controllers Support!

How to setup:
1. Make shure you connected your Controller and started the software
2. Start the game
3. Go to "Input" tab
Go down to "Steering", ignoring first set of "Gas", "Brake", etc. it's for Keyboard.

4. Select "Steering", and Double click on it
Will open the small tab, move your steering wheel upon the value will be setted.

5. Now Select "Gas", and Double click on it
Will open the small tab, press your gas pedal upon the value will be setted.

5. Select "Brake", and Double click on it
Will open the small tab, press your brake pedal upon the value will be setted.

[img]http://b.snapie.net/f5fc61fe9ce06725d8cf284de283ef5c.png[/img]

You are done! Go Drifting with your controller!
Same things with others binds: Ebrake, Shifting Up/Down, Changing camera
